decisions.reason: Formwork profile systems are core to the firm's integrated formwork offering and have established market presence despite limited recent website visibility.
Automated concrete distributor flow control aligns with the firm's strategic push into automation and remains relevant to smart factory solutions.
Magnetic formwork strips are complementary accessories, but the product line's multiple models and earlier dedicated page suggest ongoing demand.
As a magnetic formwork component it faces higher rationalization risk after similar products were dropped, but its dedicated page indicates continued support.
